_doc: Upgrade cards (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md section 8), drawn by UpgradePool. power: true marks a card that raises an attack skill's damage output (a new attack skill, its rank, more shots/targets, damage, cooldown); pity.draws = N: after N draws in a row without a power card the next draw starts with one (0 = off). kind: skill_new (learn `skill` at the tier starting rank), skill_rank (tier canonical-level gain of `skill`), skill_mod (modifies `skill`), passive / stat (player modifiers). requires (all optional): jobs (the player's current job equals one of these), carry_jobs (spec #165: further jobs that keep offering the card; the advancement draw reads jobs only), skills (owned skill keys), min_rank ({skill: rank}), min_level. skill_rank and skill_mod cards also require owning `skill`; skill_new requires not owning it; there are no skill slot caps. max_rank 0 = unlimited; skill_rank cards use the canonical skill cap, with the owned skill level also gating offers (a Normal learn starts at level 1, so N-1 Normal rank-card picks reach N). effects: {stat, op, value} applied once per rank taken; op add sums, op mul multiplies (compounds per rank). fallback is a separate filler card, excluded from weighted draws and offered once when fewer than 3 cards remain (alone when none do) and the only job-neutral card (spec #225); its heal effects restore a fraction of the relevant maximum. Skill stats: count, cooldown, pierce, speed, range, damage (multiplier), crit (chance, additive). Player stat cards: none today (removed Max HP, flat Max MP and flat speed cards are replaced by owned skills, and the Magnet card is gone: pet VAC/Binocular are the only pickup-range upgrades). rarity: seeded Potential tier weights and Fortune scaling. magnitudes: per-kind tier tables (stacking covers skill_mod/stat/passive), overridden per tier by each card magnitudes table; clamp lists tiers whose fixed request is capped by remaining headroom (unlimited cards keep the fixed request); other tiers drop to the highest fitting tier. desc: {magnitude} is the actual rank/step/starting-rank gain; {value} scales additive values or displays a compounded multiplicative percentage (two decimal places). Canonical skill caps are tier A; WZ skill prerequisites are ignored (tier C owner choice #31); card weights, modifiers and offer rules are tier C (ours). Icons are WZ paths, all imported by the asset manifest: skill cards use their own canonical Skill.wz icon and the Power Elixir fallback Item.wz/Consume 2000005. The cards live in the per-line fragments upgrades/<line>.json (common, beginner, warrior, magician, bowman, thief, pirate), concatenated in that order by DataRepo.load_all (a duplicate card id is an error); the fallback card stays here (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4).

rarity._tier: Tier C: spec #30 survivor card odds (owner restored the spec weights over C46 on 2026-10-15; tuning waits for the dedicated balance pass); non-Normal weights multiply by 1 + max(0, Fortune) * fortune_scale, then all weights normalize.

magnitudes._tier: Tier C: rank increments, modifier steps and new-skill starting ranks; each tier gives more than the one below (owner, 2026-10-15). Fixed Legendary rank +8 and stacking +5, clamped to remaining headroom; equal gains retain the lowest label (owner decision #173, 2026-10-18).
